markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (98%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier 1 frozen section [F1] with tumor at three margins [F7]; stains blocked.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 98%, InSitu 1% | Strong invasive score |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} (alpha 10%, coverage 90%) | Single-class 90% set |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100th percentile [F6] | Reliable despite atypical OOD |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (65%–70% similarity) [F5] | All neighbors invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 2, 10) · ↑ invasive · High (+1.26) [F2]; 0/20 AI spot-check · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (+0.90) [F3]; 20/20 spot-check · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (+0.78) [F4]; 0/20 spot-check · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Low (+0.59); caption inconsistent, 18/20 spot-check · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Low (-0.32) tempers call; 19/20 spot-check · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting 3 top-risk regions beats random (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (95% CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 spans 0); uses unreliable mitoses, normal lobules, necrosis.

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 resampling on simulated frozen section mimics invasion over InSitu (contrast BACH_0077, 63% similarity).
- Low infiltration (-0.32) reflects true InSitu, or edge artifacts inflate positive margin calls.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 2, 10**: Verify invasion and mitoses versus resampling artifact (HoVer-Net cells disabled).
2. **Regions 3, 6, 8**: Check infiltration/tubules (**3**), duct confinement (**6**), and scarce stroma/lobules (**8**).
3. **Regions 0–3, 3/7/11, 8–11**: Check superior (215 um), lateral (215 um), inferior (108 um) margins.
